_comment: Manifest of fired experiments: label, branch/cfg, seeds, prediction pointer, fired-at, collected-at, status. Added 2026-08-10 per external audit point 8 -- orchestration state (what's running, what's been processed) was living only in session memory and LEDGER prose, both of which are lossy. Update this on every fire and every collection. A session picking up this project should reconcile fired-vs-collected here before trusting any 'what's currently running' claim made in conversation.
_schema: label -> {cfg, seeds, build, prediction_ref (LEDGER.md section), fired_at (UTC, approximate where reconstructed), status: fired|partially_collected|collected|invalidated, notes}
